ques: Open the Labrador Retriever breed profile and report the registration code AKC lists for its Chocolate coat colour.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the Labrador Retriever breed profile page. The final answer MUST state the registration code shown in that page's colours table for the Chocolate colour. A code for a different colour, a code for a different breed, or an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Use the Breed Selector for an apartment home with Energy Level 2, Coat Grooming Frequency 2, Good With Young Children 5 and Trainability Level 4, then report the breed shown first in the recommendations.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have submitted the breed selector form with those five settings. The final answer MUST name the breed that the resulting recommendation list shows first. Naming a breed further down the list, or answering without submitting the form, is a FAIL.

ques: Compare the Golden Retriever and the Border Collie on the compare page, then report each breed's Energy Level rating and which of the two is higher.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the compare page with both breeds selected. The final answer MUST give both Energy Level ratings as shown there and MUST identify which breed is higher. Reporting only one rating, swapping the two, or naming the wrong higher breed is a FAIL.

ques: Log in with the demo account (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!) and report the three breeds already saved in that profile.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have signed in and reached the account page. The final answer MUST list all three saved breed names shown there. Missing one, inventing a breed that is not saved, or an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Sort the breed directory by popularity ranking, then report the three lowest-ranked breeds in the directory with their ranking numbers.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have loaded the breed directory sorted by popularity ranking. The final answer MUST name the three breeds carrying the highest ranking numbers in this directory and give those numbers. Listing the most popular breeds instead, or omitting the numbers, is a FAIL.

ques: Filter the event search to the Conformation sport, open the AKC National Championship, and report which breed groups that event page says are judged on Saturday.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have filtered the event search to Conformation and opened the AKC National Championship event page. The final answer MUST list the breed groups that page states are judged on Saturday. Answering from the event list without opening the event page, or naming groups the page does not list, is a FAIL.

ques: Filter Expert Advice to the Nutrition category, then report how many articles are listed and the title of the one published earliest.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have filtered Expert Advice to the Nutrition category. The final answer MUST give the number of articles listed in that category AND the title of the one with the earliest publication date. A wrong count, or the title of a later article, is a FAIL.

ques: Filter the breed directory to the Working Group, then report how many breeds are listed and which of those breeds is NOT in AKC's Largest Dog Breeds collection.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have filtered the breed directory to the Working Group and MUST also have consulted AKC's Largest Dog Breeds collection (via the collection filter or a breed profile). The final answer MUST give the Working Group count AND name the one Working Group breed absent from the Largest Dog Breeds collection. Naming a breed that is in the collection is a FAIL.

ques: Log in with the demo account (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!), then register a dog named Scout in the Novice class for the AKC Rally National Championship.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have signed in, opened the AKC Rally National Championship event page and submitted its registration form with the dog name Scout and the Novice class. The registration MUST actually exist afterwards. Claiming success without the registration being recorded is a FAIL.

ques: Log in with the demo account (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!) and change the owner profile activity level to Low, then confirm the account page shows the change.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have signed in and submitted the owner profile form with the activity level set to Low. The stored profile MUST show Low afterwards. Reporting the change without it being saved is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Great Dane breed profile and report the height range AKC lists for males.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the Great Dane breed profile. The final answer MUST give the male height range exactly as the page states it. Giving the female range, mixing the two, or giving a weight instead is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Labrador Retriever breed profile and report what its Did You Know section says about where the breed actually came from.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the Labrador Retriever breed profile. The final answer MUST reproduce the origin claim made in that page's Did You Know section. An answer that contradicts the page, or that repeats only the breed name, is a FAIL.

ques: Find the only breed in this directory that AKC lists under Hypoallergenic Dogs, then open its profile and report its Shedding Level rating.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have used the Hypoallergenic Dogs collection to identify the breed and MUST have opened that breed's profile. The final answer MUST name the breed AND give the Shedding Level rating shown on its profile. A rating for a different trait or a different breed is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Siberian Husky breed profile and report its Barking Level rating and its Drooling Level rating.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the Siberian Husky breed profile. The final answer MUST give both ratings as shown on that page and MUST attach each rating to the right trait. Swapping the two ratings is a FAIL.

ques: Log in with the demo account (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!), then save the Whippet to the profile and confirm it appears in the saved breeds list.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have signed in, opened the Whippet breed profile and used its save control. The Whippet MUST actually be saved to that account afterwards, alongside the breeds already there. Claiming success without the save being recorded is a FAIL.

ques: Create a new AKC account with full name Jordan Blake, username jordan_b, email jordan.b@test.com and password TestPass123!, choosing Condo as the household, then confirm the account page shows Jordan Blake.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have submitted the registration form with exactly those details and reached the signed-in account page. The account MUST actually exist afterwards with that username, email and household. Reusing the existing demo account instead of creating this one is a FAIL.

ques: Search the site for agility and report how many Expert Advice results and how many event results the search returns.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have run the site search for agility. The final answer MUST give both counts as the results page reports them, each attached to the right section. Reporting a single total, or swapping the two counts, is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Rottweiler breed profile and report all three coat colours AKC lists, each with its registration code.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: the agent MUST have opened the Rottweiler breed profile. The final answer MUST list all three colour names from that page's colours table, each paired with its correct registration code. Missing a colour, or pairing a colour with the wrong code, is a FAIL.
